first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses the current completion and activation declines and has prior evidence of durable early-adoption gains. Promotional pricing is the strongest competing response to SMB losses, but its evidence must be checked for retention, margin, and long-term revenue quality before prioritizing it. The onboarding evidence also needs verification because improved early adoption does not by itself establish sustainable long-term qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. Verified evidence shows completion increased 13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its 18% qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower 30-day retention and failure through first renewal. Measure completion, activation, retained qualified revenue, and segment-level effects before any broader rollout.
